rows.note: Use this when acknowledging a favour by expressing thanks.

example.english: I acknowledge your help—thanks for helping me move house.
example.jyutping: do1 ze6 nei5 bong1 ngo5 bun1 uk1

rows.note: Use this when recognizing someone’s identity, status, relationship, or authority.

example.english: I acknowledge him as my older brother.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jan6 keoi5 hai6 ngo5 aa3 go1

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for admitting that a fact or belief is true.

example.english: I acknowledge that I was wrong this time.
example.jyutping: ngo5 sing4 jing6 ni1 ci3 hai6 ngo5 co3

rows.traditional: 覆 A 話收到 B
rows.jyutping: fuk1 A waa6 sau1 dou2 B
rows.note: Use this when replying to someone to report that you received their message, document, or invitation.

example.english: I reply to acknowledge that I received the document.
example.traditional: 我覆佢話收到份文件喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 fuk1 keoi5 waa6 sau1 dou2 fan6 man4 gin2 laa3
